name: Aspect
long_description:
Aspect helps creative teams consolidate 5 media tools into one platform. We provide everything a media team needs: file ingest, local file streaming, review and approval, sharing, and archiving. 

Aspect workspaces come with an agent that has complete understanding of your asset library including comments and revisions. Ask the agent to complete any task in the background: searching for files, setting up folder structures, labeling and organizing footage, and much more.

Check out https://aspect.inc/use-cases to see how different media teams use Aspect to deliver content faster.

launches.title: Aspect: Intelligent media storage for creative teams.
launches.tagline: Aspect is the creative asset management platform that lets teams store, stream, review, and archive media in one place.
launches.body:
# TL;DR

Your editor shouldn't have to download 100GB to start cutting. Your producer shouldn't have to re-upload that same file to review it. And nobody should be Slacking “which Dropbox folder is the latest version?” at 11pm. Aspect is the single platform where footage goes from upload, to local editor timeline, to client review link, without touching a second tool. Oh, and every workspace has an AI agent that knows every face, every word, and every frame across your entire library.

# What Aspect does:

[**Cloud storage that connects like a hard drive:**](https://aspect.inc/features/instant-access) Aspect mounts to your desktop like an SSD, and streams the bytes your application needs, so a 200GB R3D timeline plays back the moment you double-click it, even if your laptop only has 50GB free. Every project change syncs in real time across your team, so everyone can work on the same timeline.

**Agentic search and work:** For the first time, a media platform comes with an AI agent that actually understands your content. Say _“collect everything from the Chicago shoot with the client’s logo, add it to a collection, and send a view-only link to the client”_ and it just does it.

[**Review and approve:**](https://aspect.inc/features/review-and-approve) Every asset your team uploads or exports to the Aspect drive is instantly reviewable. Frame-accurate commenting, markup tools, version comparison, and customizable share links are built into every file.

# How do I actually use this?

Use Aspect as your team’s single source of truth for media files on the cloud and locally on your desktop. Our team will copy over any files your team already has on Dropbox, Google Drive, Frameio, or any other platform for free.

**1)** Start by mounting a project from Aspect to your local desktop. Your project shows up as a hard drive on your computer. Open any file, no matter how large, and we will stream the bytes your computer needs to play back the video instantly. Any changes you make in a Premiere, Resolve, or Final Cut project show up for everyone else on your team in their timeline as well.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101753&key=user_uploads/1087643/f374bc9d-a686-414a-9a8e-4547c8f89e92)

**2)** When you are looking for a piece of media, ask the Aspect agent to retrieve it for you. Right click on a file and open it directly in Finder:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101753&key=user_uploads/1087643/60636a50-1da5-4665-bd15-603f12eae6bd)

**3)** When you are done with a rough or final cut, export the file back to the Aspect drive. New files sync across everyone who has the project mounted, and a preview will be generated automatically for your team to view the file on any browser:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101753&key=user_uploads/1087643/6eb26f19-ec05-4d2e-b8e7-1136fcc3224f)

**4)** Review, markup, comment, and share this file the same way you would on any platform:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101753&key=user_uploads/1087643/f20bd7b5-59d4-4552-8a00-c4aa63037f10)

And when you are done with a project or campaign, move them to archive storage with one click where your team can still view, search, and share assets.

# Aspect is how teams save dozens of hours and thousands of dollars working with their media.

Media teams today are forced to stitch together multiple point solutions because there wasn't a platform that could do it all. Files lived in Dropbox, reviews live in Frameio, and editors streamed from LucidLink. That’s three subscriptions, three sources of truth, none of them connected. Aspect replaces all three, built with an agent that’s like having a DIT who’s already watched every frame.

### **Do us a favor**

If you know someone that works in post-production, **send them this post!** If you are someone who works at a post-house, creative agency, or an in-house creative team, let’s see how we can help your team ship content faster: <https://cal.com/team/aspect/aspect-for-teams>

launches.body:
Hey! We’re Edison, Gurish, and Bright - founders of [Aspect](https://aspect.inc) 🎥 💥

### **TL;DR**

We’ve spent **10,000+ hours** with in-house content teams as the founding members of a media asset management company, learning every broken part of their workflow. Post-production supervisors and assistants still have to organize folders, check revisions, comb through old content, and update data across project management tools, not to mention constant upkeep with clients. These are just a few of the manual tasks keeping creatives from doing what they love.

**Aspect takes care of everything and more.**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1EwHnYKPWBo>

### What Aspect Does:

* Ingests media from traditional post-production storage apps and NAS storage
* Crawls every frame of video to create a humanlike understanding of whole libraries
* Connects to other business tools to keep data in sync without human intervention
* Searches for second-accurate clips, assembles rough cuts, reviews footage, creates folder trees - anything a post-production expert can do, Aspect can do

Aspect is the single source of truth from ingest, to rough cut, and final delivery, with agents you can send off to do the mundane work you hate.

### How do I actually use this?

Ask Aspect to pull your latest storyboard from an external app, or upload a PDF and ask it to assemble a rough cut from your latest shoot:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94992&key=user_uploads/1087643/8622bede-339a-44b8-bcde-f48fa6304dc7)

Use the @ in a comment like you would with a teammate and ask Aspect to review a video based on revision notes from a previous version or another app:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94992&key=user_uploads/1087643/de627308-8f5b-4e4d-8dc5-b14fa894a57a)

…and so much more.

### Aspect is the Future of media Production:

Previous waves of media-tech only focused on simplifying media retrieval with brittle tagging and non-actionable semantic search. The reality is that searching for files is just a fraction of the time wasted by post-production teams. Aspect is built on agents with humanlike **visual-temporal understanding**, so they _go beyond_ _just search_ - they work with video like any post-production teammate and can scale infinitely.

### Our Story:

We’re [Edison](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edison-chiu/), [Gurish](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gurish-sharma-/), and [Bright](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brightxu/)! We spent 3 years learning about every role in post-production teams across thousands of companies. Post-production is by far the most human labor concentrated task in the creative journey, which is why we are building _the autonomous layer_ for the $200B video production industry.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94992&key=user_uploads/1087643/80f3db12-ae95-4e7b-afbf-1e6e14e5d0e9)
